Package com.example.helloworldproject.model

Class NotificationRecord

java.lang.Object
com.example.helloworldproject.model.NotificationRecord
public class NotificationRecord extends Object
Simple in-app notification model that is stored under:

profiles/{profileId}/notifications/{notificationId}

It is used to notify entrants about lottery results (e.g. "you were not chosen for this event").
